description: Find MCP servers for a tool or job (e.g. 'postgres', 'slack', 'web scraping', 'invoices') in the MeWeApps directory of 4,500+ servers imported from the official MCP Registry and submitted by authors. Every word must appear in the server's name, tagline or description. Returns each server's name, what it does, install options (remote URL, npm, PyPI, Docker), repository and its meweapps.com page with copy-paste configs. Results follow the directory's own order (featured listings first); this is not a quality ranking.

query.description: Words to search for, e.g. 'postgres' or 'google calendar'

remote_only.description: Only servers with a hosted remote endpoint (no local install)

name: search_mcp_servers
title: Search the MeWeApps MCP server directory
